title: High-density internal operations tool
prompt: Internal tool for our support team: ticket queue with 200+ rows visible, filters, bulk actions, keyboard shortcuts, detail side panel. They live in this 8 hours a day. React + TypeScript. Density over beauty.

must: Terminal-density register: VISUAL_DENSITY 8-9, dividers over cards, 4px rhythm
MOTION_INTENSITY 1: instant states documented as a decision, will-not-animate list
Keyboard-first: shortcuts, roving focus in the queue, visible focus everywhere
Virtualization for the 200+ row list; content-length stress on ticket titles
Touch-target floors still respected despite density (24px desktop minimum)
must_not: Marketing components or decorative empty states
Card grids where a table serves
